note: Every entry is an irregularity or an unverified value found in this session. Format rule: if a value could not be confirmed from an official source it is left blank in the tables and described here, never inferred.

flags.item: The repository's stored 'official' snapshot is dated 2026-11-02 and is now out of date
flags.detail: official/*.json and data/*.json hold the 2026-11-02 transposition. On 2026-11-05 the league has played 36 more games, so every standings row has moved. This site publishes a new 2026-11-05 snapshot and leaves the old files untouched for audit; the old snapshot is not republished as current.
flags.impact: Superseded — no value from 2026-11-02 is presented as current on this site.

flags.item: The verified game sample covers 85 of the 121 games played (70.2%)
flags.detail: The sample contains the six dates whose rows already existed in the repository (2026-10-21, 10-23, 10-28, 10-30, 10-31, 11-01) plus the two dates re-read this session (2026-11-02, 11-04). Seven dates were never captured: 2026-10-20 (3 games), 10-22 (2), 10-24 (8), 10-25 (7), 10-26 (9), 10-27 (4), 10-29 (3) = 36 games. Those dates were not fetched in this session, so no value from them appears anywhere.
flags.impact: Model ratings and every backtest number are computed on 70.2% of the season to date. Coverage is stated on every affected page.

flags.item: The 30 published team +/- values do not sum to zero
flags.detail: Sum of the official per-game differentials = -5.3. Mean points scored 113.44 vs mean implied points allowed 113.62 (gap +0.18). Every game awards identical points to both teams, so the true league-wide sum is exactly zero; pure one-decimal rounding allows at most about 1.5. Cause unexplained. A single-team spot check on 2026-11-05 confirms the column itself is being read correctly: the Chicago Bulls page shows -18.0 and its own OPPG header (129.6) gives 111.6 - 129.6 = -18.0. Values are therefore published exactly as displayed, and the column is not used as a model input.
flags.impact: No correction applied. The model derives ratings only from final scores, so no result depends on this column.

flags.item: No official betting price exists in any official NBA source, so expected value and return are not computable
flags.detail: The official games page renders a 'HIDE ODDS' control, but no price values appeared in the retrieved page text, and no NBA page publishes a settlement price history. Whether such displayed prices are NBA data or a partner feed is not established. Every price field on this site is therefore blank and gate G7 is BLOCKED, not failed.
flags.impact: No ROI, no closing-line value, no profit claim. The competition awards nothing.

flags.item: NBA Stats FAQ restricts downloading their statistics
flags.detail: The NBA Stats FAQ states that statistics are not available for download for either academic or personal use. No scraping, API extraction or bulk copy was performed: only the displayed values needed for this research were read from public pages, and each carries its official URL. This restriction is a standing legal/ToS constraint on scaling the dataset.
flags.impact: Dataset growth is deliberately limited to manual verification-scale transcription.

flags.item: No official player game logs, so player-prop distributions and prop-pair correlations cannot be measured
flags.detail: Only four official season-average rows (PPG/RPG/APG for the season leader of each team on the 11/05 slate) were available. Per-game variance, hit rates around a line, teammate-to-teammate correlation and minutes/role risk all require game logs that are not available under the official-source rule. Any over/under probability for a prop would be invented, so the columns are blank.
flags.impact: Strategies S6 (prop single) and S7 (prop combo) are blocked at the data layer, not merely unprofitable. Prop lines are published as reference points only.

flags.item: The 56 inherited game rows were not individually re-fetched in this session
flags.detail: Those rows carry their own official source URL and official game link. They were corroborated in two mechanical ways: every date in the sample holds exactly the number of games the official calendar lists (check C06), and each team's inherited record advanced by exactly its results in the newly verified games (check C05, 30/30 teams). Row-by-row re-fetch is still outstanding.
flags.impact: Rows are labelled 'inherited, corroborated' rather than 're-read'; they are never labelled freshly verified.

flags.item: The one nominally significant result does not survive multiple-testing control
flags.detail: The originated total beat the naive running-average baseline with permutation p = 0.0261 on 35 graded games. With two strategy-level tests in this run, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 sets the smallest admissible threshold at 0.025, so the result fails. It also fails the 300-game sample floor by a wide margin.
flags.impact: Not an edge. Reported as a nominal, unsustained result and excluded from the leaderboard.

flags.item: Player availability is not transcribed, so originated team lines ignore injuries
flags.detail: The official injury report page exists and is the required pre-bet availability check, but individual player statuses were not transcribed into this snapshot and are not modelled. A line originated here is a team-strength line, not a market line.
flags.impact: Every originated line is annotated as availability-blind.

flags.item: Third-party data elsewhere in the repository is excluded from this snapshot
flags.detail: The repository contains raw ESPN scoreboard/summary JSON (data/raw/espn/) and research built on a third-party GitHub mirror. None of it is official NBA data. It is not used, not re-published and not promoted anywhere on this site.
flags.impact: This site's numbers come only from nba.com, official.nba.com and this repository's own verified files.

flags.item: The repository carries several overlapping dashboards built by parallel sessions
flags.detail: Root site, pages/, docs/, lab/, lines-lab/, nba-evidence/site/ and four NFL workspaces all exist. This session makes the root dashboard the single clean entry point and links every other workspace as retained material; no peer file was edited or deleted.
flags.impact: A reader can still reach every prior workspace, but only one landing page is canonical.

flags.item: Home-court edge is estimated from a partial sample and heavily shrunk
flags.detail: The measured home edge is 1.36 points per game on 85 games, with shrinkage k = 20 toward zero, pre-registered before the run. That is far below the commonly quoted ~2.5-3 points and is not stable at this sample size.
flags.impact: Home advantage is a weak input; no conclusion is drawn from its magnitude.

flags.item: GitHub Pages deploys through the repository's legacy main/root configuration, not a dedicated workflow
flags.detail: The Pages API reports build_type 'legacy', source main, path '/', status 'built'. No Pages-setting change was attempted. Site validation is done by verification/verify_site.py and verification/assert_publication.py, which run locally and in CI, but the deployment itself is the platform's legacy build. Note: a rebuild on a different C library can move a last-digit p-value through libm/tie effects, so CI enforces byte-identical transcription plus numerical invariants rather than a whole-site byte diff; this was observed when the first validation run on the runner differed from the local rebuild.
flags.impact: The site is static; there is no server-side computation and no external runtime dependency.
